description: Ordinal recursion has a zero case, a successor case, and a nonzero-limit case using all earlier values.
signature:
Ordinal.limitRecOn.{u_4, u_5} {motive : Ordinal.{u_5} → Sort u_4} (o : Ordinal.{u_5}) (zero : motive 0)
  (add_one : (o : Ordinal.{u_5}) → motive o → motive (o + 1))
  (limit : (o : Ordinal.{u_5}) → Order.IsSuccLimit o → ((o' : Ordinal.{u_5}) → o' < o → motive o') → motive o) :
  motive o
